preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10.
Number of integers N on the blackboard is between 6 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A_i <= 10**9 for A_i in A)
preconditions.description: Each integer A_i on the blackboard is between 0 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: Number of operations M is between 0 and 11111.

postconditions.expression: all(A in A and B in A and C in A for A, B, C in operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation uses integers A, B, and C that are present on the blackboard.

postconditions.expression: all((A ^ B, B ^ C, C ^ A) == (0, 0, 0) for A, B, C in operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation results in writing 0, 0, 0 back onto the blackboard.
All numbers on the blackboard are 0 after performing the operations.
